full_page.content:
1952, May 6
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY Route 8 Huntington, Indiana
May 6, 1952
Miss Margaret Belain 8784 Morley St. Detroit, Michigan
Blessed be God in all His designs.
God bless you Miss Belain, you and yours:
I hope you are well and that things are coming favorably for you. I am sure my failure to acknowledge your appreciated favor of December 6th last, must have been deeply disapointing. Please pardon! I can hardly explain further than that, wish- ing to thank you personaly for such a favor, I put your brief letter aside and, some how or other it was simply "snowd under."
However, I am sure God has blessed you just the same, and you have been included in our prayers as noted at the time. Besides this, I am going to offer my first - next - "Free Mass" for your intentions, your guidance, and welfare. Incidently we have the privilege of two such "free-Masse " each month.
Thanking you a million for your kindness and hoping such failure on my part may not occur in the future, I beg to remain, at your service,
Sincerely yours in Christ,
Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. Cap.
Glory be to God.
